description: Land Acquisition - Pitawala, Ambagamuwa, Koralaya D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1977/03 of 25.07.2016 by Mahawewa D/S Diviisons
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains declarations under Section 5 for acquiring specific land parcels ("Broadland Estate") for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations. It also includes a correction notice related to a previous land acquisition gazette.
